annotation.bound_parties_text: The guidelines apply to trial organizations (companies and organizations such as OEMs, technology companies, and academic or research institutions) conducting research and development trials of ADS-equipped vehicles in Canada.
annotation.bound_parties_quote: The Testing Guidelines apply to any organization that is conducting research and development trials of ADS-equipped vehicles
annotation.dates_quote: Version 2.0 of the Testing Guidelines replaces the previous version of this document published by Transport Canada in 2018.
annotation.robot_provision_quote: Guidelines for Testing Automated Driving Systems in Canada: Version 2.0 (referred to hereafter as the Testing Guidelines) establishes a baseline of nationally consistent best practices
